Task: Bulk Modulus of Silicon
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of silicon by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use reaxff potential and the given parameters for the simulation. Make sure to include charge equilibration using fix qeq/reaxff. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: real
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-149
- atom_style: full
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

messages.content:
Now, let's create the LAMMPS input script for elastic constant calculation. I'll write a script that will:
1. Set up the simulation with proper units and atom style
2. Use the ReaxFF potential
3. Include charge equilibration
4. Calculate elastic constants through finite deformations

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/silicon_bulk_modulus_trial_4/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p
newton on

# Read structure
read_data Si.data

# ReaxFF potential
pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/ffield.reax.Si Si

# Set up charge equilibration
fix QEQ all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1.0e-6 reaxff

# Energy minimization settings
min_style cg
min_modify line quadratic
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Define variables for elastic constant calculation
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output settings
thermo_style custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz lx ly lz vol
thermo 1

# Store initial box dimensions
variable tmp equal "lx"
variable L0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "ly"
variable L1 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "lz"
variable L2 equal ${tmp}

# Define deformation matrices for 6 independent strains
# Strain 1 (xx)
variable dir equal 1
displace_box all x scale 1.000001 remap units box
run 0
variable tmp equal "pxx"
variable p1${dir} equal ${tmp}
displace_box all x scale 0.999998 remap units box
run 0
variable tmp equal "pxx"
variable p2${dir} equal ${tmp}
displace_box all x scale 1.000001 remap units box

# Strain 2 (yy)
variable dir equal 2
displace_box all y scale 1.000001 remap units box
run 0
variable tmp equal "pyy"
variable p1${dir} equal ${tmp}
displace_box all y scale 0.999998 remap units box
run 0
variable tmp equal "pyy"
variable p2${dir} equal ${tmp}
displace_box all y scale 1.000001 remap units box

# Strain 3 (zz)
variable dir equal 3
displace_box all z scale 1.000001 remap units box
run 0
variable tmp equal "pzz"
variable p1${dir} equal ${tmp}
displace_box all z scale 0.999998 remap units box
run 0
variable tmp equal "pzz"
variable p2${dir} equal ${tmp}
displace_box all z scale 1.000001 remap units box

# Calculate elastic constants
variable C11 equal (-${p21}+${p11})/(2.0*${up})
variable C22 equal (-${p22}+${p12})/(2.0*${up})
variable C33 equal (-${p23}+${p13})/(2.0*${up})

# Calculate bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable B equal (${C11}+${C22}+${C33})/9.0

# Output results
print "Bulk Modulus = ${B} atmospheres""}
